newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: BT to hold stake in Singapore telcom group.
newsitem.headline: BT to hold stake in Singapore telcom group.

text.p: British Telecommunications Plc (BT) would hold about 20 percent in a Singapore consortium which is bidding for a basic telecom licence in Singapore, said Peter Bonsield, chief executive officer of BT on Wednesday.
Bonsield told reporters in Singapore he would not rule out mobile opportunities in Singapore in the future.
He said Japan's Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp (NTT) will also hold about a 20 percent stake in the group.
The other members of the consortium include Singapore Technologies Telemedia and Singapore Power.
The group is bidding for Singapore's second basic telecom services license which will be awarded in 1998.

The Singapore government had earlier said it would allow at least one and possibly two new operators to operate fixed line telephone services. Another bidder for the second license is a consortium led by Singapore Press Holdings.
Singapore Technologies Telemedia is part of government-owned Singapore Technologies while Singapore Power is a utility and energy group.
